# OPC UA NodeSet schema

`UANodeSet.xsd` is an unmodified file from [OPC Foundation UA-Nodeset](https://github.com/OPCFoundation/UA-Nodeset/blob/4194ae486d36166d6997de9946d361ec2ce4a4fe/Schema/UANodeSet.xsd), commit `4194ae486d36166d6997de9946d361ec2ce4a4fe`.

SHA-256: `c7ac09ea7504d54174e1eb4c5a8123c0cc491040703dfcd6bfe085bf6c53f9f0`.
The embedded schema declares model version 1.05.04, publication date 2024-12-01.
The upstream file declares copyright 2026 OPC Foundation and SPDX license MIT; the accompanying license reproduces those terms.

This schema checks the general NodeSet envelope only. Its presence does not establish the dialect, mapping extensions, model versions or features accepted by a Siemens target. Validation never downloads a schema or resolves a namespace URI.
